title: Pinterest-to-Nanobanana Prompt Schema
description: Strict schema for every prompt produced by the pinterest-to-nanobanana skill. All fields are required. The natural-language prompt that accompanies each JSON must contain every field value expanded into fluent English without summarization.

prompt_n.description: Which of the 5 prompts this is.

improvement_axis.description: Which of the 5 improvement axes this prompt executes.

improvement_note.description: Short sentence explaining which Starting Image Delta item this prompt addresses and how.

cast_reference.description: The full Protagonist Casting brief from Step 2, inlined verbatim. Includes age range, physical features, face shape, hair, eyebrows, eyes, eyelashes, nose, mouth, teeth, skin character, body presence, unique scroll-stopper, styling direction, default expression.

pose.description: Specific body position adapted to this scene.

gaze.description: Direction plus quality plus emotional content of the gaze.

expression.description: Exact emotional register on the face.

hands_gesture.description: What the hands are doing, including finger position if visible.

key_surfaces.description: Each entry: surface + material (e.g., 'travertine floor with warm veining').

atmospheric_elements.description: Haze, dust motes, steam, light leak, etc. Or 'none'.

dna_full.description: The Product DNA FULL string: baseline bamboo viscose string plus the full Bamboo Viscose Fabric Realism Block from references/realism_blocks.md. Used identically in all 5 prompts of the session.

placement.description: Exact physical placement of the textile in the scene: draped where, pooling where, touching which body part or surface.

key_direction.description: Precise direction of the key light (e.g., 'from the upper left, 45-degree angle above horizon').

shadow_behavior.description: Soft gradient / hard-edged / pooled under elements / sculpting the face.

highlight_behavior.description: Specular / diffused / rim / edge-only / satin on skin.

secondary_sources.description: Fill light, bounce light, ambient glow — described specifically.

depth_layers.description: Foreground / midground / background with sharpness for each.

key_element_preserved.description: The single soul-element from the Pinterest reference that this variant preserves.

body.description: Fixed to Canon R5 across the skill.

face.description: Full Human Face Realism Block from references/realism_blocks.md, inlined verbatim. If no face is visible in the frame, set this to the string 'N/A — no face in frame'.

fabric.description: Full Bamboo Viscose Fabric Realism Block from references/realism_blocks.md, inlined verbatim. Always required — product is always in frame.

materials.description: The relevant Environmental Material Realism Blocks for this scene, inlined verbatim. Only include blocks for materials actually present.

light_on_surfaces.description: Full Light on Skin and Fabric Block from references/realism_blocks.md, inlined verbatim. If no skin is in frame, provide an equivalent light-on-fabric-and-materials description instead.

anti_ai_cues.description: Full Anti-AI Cues Block from references/realism_blocks.md, inlined verbatim.
